study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Fraza et al., Nature Mental Health, 2024
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Unraveling the link between CNVs, cognition and individual neuroimaging deviation scores from a population-based reference cohort

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study utilized five large-scale neuroimaging datasets: UK Biobank (used for both the IDP-based and Jacobian-based models), and a pooled lifespan sample for the Jacobian model comprising Cam-CAN, HCP (Young Adult), OASIS-3, and PNC.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: study_1/Fraza2023.pdf.md: Methods / Participant demographics and data sources
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: To create the voxel-wise Jacobian normative model that spans the entire age range, we pooled a large dataset from five publicly available repositories: Cam-CAN, HCP, Oasis, PNC and UK Biobank

answer.UK Biobank: normative training and testing (reference cohort) for IDP and Jacobian models; clinical evaluation set for pathogenic CNV carriers

answer.Cam-CAN: normative training and testing (reference cohort) for the voxel-wise Jacobian model

answer.HCP-YA: normative training and testing (reference cohort) for the voxel-wise Jacobian model

answer.OASIS-3: normative training and testing (reference cohort) for the voxel-wise Jacobian model

answer.PNC: normative training and testing (reference cohort) for the voxel-wise Jacobian model

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: The UK Biobank was the primary dataset for IDP modeling and the source of clinical subjects (pathogenic CNV carriers). For the high-precision Jacobian model, all five datasets were pooled to create a reference cohort spanning the lifespan (8-97 years).
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: study_1/Fraza2023.pdf.md: Results; Methods / Participant demographics and data sources
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: Initially, we fit a normative model to each of the image-derived phenotypes (IDPs) ... from the UK Biobank. ... To create the voxel-wise Jacobian normative model ... we pooled a large dataset from five publicly available repositories: Cam-CAN, HCP, Oasis, PNC and UK Biobank

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: For Model 1 (IDP), Table 1 reports 43,893 participants without CNVs. For Model 2 (Jacobian), Fig 2 specifies a reference cohort of 19,245. The study employed a 50-50 train-test split (train phase N calculated as half of HC N, rounded down).
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.location: study_1/Fraza2023.pdf.md: Table 1; Fig 2; study_1/Fraza2023_sup1.pdf.md: Normative model formulation
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: In total, for the IDP study, we used 43,893 participants [reference]. ... Analysis 2 (T1 Jacobians) ... Reference Cohort N=19,245. ... Our dataset was divided into a 50-50 train-test split.

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Model 1 age stats are directly from Table 1 for UKB-IDP. Model 2 overall age stats are calculated as weighted mean and pooled SD from the five reference groups listed in Table 2 (Cam-CAN, HCP, OASIS 3, PNC, and UKB HC part). Range for Model 2 is the combined min-max (8 to 97 years).

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Model 1 sex distribution is from Table 1. Model 2 sex counts were calculated by summing the female and male counts from each reference dataset in Table 2, with the UKB count adjusted to exclude the 375 CNV carriers (assuming UKB HC N = 14,037 as inferred from Fig 2).
